sentences.text: Marnie is a 1964 American psychological thriller film directed by Alfred Hitchcock .	Alfred Hitchcock	Alfred Hitchcock	Marnie	Marnie	psychological thriller film	psychological thriller
The screenplay by Jay Presson Allen was based on the 1961 novel of the same name by Winston Graham .	Jay Presson Allen	Jay Presson Allen	Winston Graham	Winston Graham	novel of the same name	Marnie
The film stars Tippi Hedren and Sean Connery .	Tippi Hedren	Tippi Hedren	Sean Connery	Sean Connery
The music was composed by Bernard Herrmann , his last of seven critically acclaimed film scores for Hitchcock .	Bernard Herrmann	Bernard Herrmann

Marnie also marked the end of Hitchcock 's collaborations with cinematographer Robert Burks -LRB- his twelfth film for Hitchcock -RRB- and editor George Tomasini -LRB- who died later in the year -RRB- .
